query:
WITH rows AS (
 SELECT entity_type,updated_by,photo_url,website,profile,
 CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(profile->'_enrich')='object' THEN profile->'_enrich' ELSE '{}'::jsonb END q
 FROM zoi.listings WHERE publish_status='published' AND moderation_status IN ('clean','cleared') AND coalesce(marketplace_status,'')<>'hidden'
), classified AS (
 SELECT *,
 (coalesce(q->>'hero_url','')<>'' OR coalesce(q->>'photo_url','')<>'' OR coalesce(q->>'logo_url','')<>'' OR (jsonb_typeof(q->'photo_urls')='array' AND q->'photo_urls'<>'[]')) AS machine_media,
 (coalesce(q->>'source_url','')<>'') AS source_present,
 (q->>'source_kind' IN ('association_directory','association_member') OR q->>'identity_scope'='organization'
 OR q->>'blocked_reason'='source_scope_mismatch' OR coalesce(q->>'organization_identity_quarantine','false') NOT IN ('false','null','')
 OR coalesce(q->>'scope_review_required','false') NOT IN ('false','null','') OR coalesce(q->>'source_affiliation','false') NOT IN ('false','null','')
 OR coalesce(q->>'association_member','false') NOT IN ('false','null','') OR coalesce(q#>>'{member,affiliation}','false') NOT IN ('false','null','')) AS quarantine,
 CASE WHEN updated_by='suite-bizpage' THEN website WHEN profile ? 'website' THEN profile->>'website' ELSE website END effective_website
 FROM rows
), binding AS (
 SELECT *, coalesce(
 effective_website ~* '^https?://[^/?#@]+([/?#]|$)' AND q->>'source_url' ~* '^https?://[^/?#@]+([/?#]|$)'
 AND regexp_replace(lower(substring(effective_website FROM '(?i)^https?://([^/?#]+)')),'^www[.]','')=regexp_replace(lower(substring(q->>'source_url' FROM '(?i)^https?://([^/?#]+)')),'^www[.]','')
 AND (coalesce(nullif(substring(effective_website FROM '(?i)^https?://[^/?#]+([^?#]*)'),''),'/')='/' OR regexp_replace(coalesce(nullif(substring(effective_website FROM '(?i)^https?://[^/?#]+([^?#]*)'),''),'/'),'/$','')=regexp_replace(coalesce(nullif(substring(q->>'source_url' FROM '(?i)^https?://[^/?#]+([^?#]*)'),''),'/'),'/$','')),false) AS source_bound_estimate FROM classified
)
SELECT entity_type,count(*) eligible,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE machine_media) machine_media,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE machine_media AND NOT source_present) unbound_machine_media,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE machine_media AND source_bound_estimate AND NOT coalesce(quarantine,false)) bound_machine_media,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE machine_media AND source_present AND NOT source_bound_estimate AND NOT coalesce(quarantine,false)) mismatched_machine_media,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE machine_media AND coalesce(quarantine,false)) quarantined_machine_media,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE updated_by='suite-bizpage') suite_owner_base,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE profile->>'hero_kind'='event_poster') authored_event_poster,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE (profile ? 'hero_url' OR profile ? 'photo_url') AND (profile->>'hero_url' IS NULL AND profile->>'photo_url' IS NULL)) explicit_image_clear
FROM binding GROUP BY entity_type ORDER BY entity_type;
source_binding_scope: Inventory estimate normalizes www and compares host/port/path; public selector also canonicalizes default ports and checks exact owner layers. Counts classify compatibility cohorts; do not claim source content correctness.
